crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A small, high-contrast white elliptical patch is visible on the lateral-posterior region of the neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct; the gray plumage of the crown transitions into the mantle without a clear linear boundary, though a red patch is present at the cranial apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a red patch on the crown and high-contrast black-and-white horizontal barring across the tail feathers.
